scenes.head: WHERE IS YOUR CRYPTO?
scenes.narration: Where do you keep your crypto? Most beginners never ask.

scenes.head: ON AN EXCHANGE
scenes.narration: Most beginners leave it on an exchange. It's easy, like a bank account.

scenes.head: NOT YOUR KEYS, NOT YOUR COINS
scenes.narration: But the exchange holds the keys. And whoever holds the keys, holds the coins.

scenes.head: EXCHANGES CAN FAIL
scenes.narration: Exchanges can get hacked, or freeze withdrawals when it matters most.

scenes.head: A WALLET = YOUR KEYS
scenes.narration: A wallet puts the keys in your hands.

scenes.head: CONTROL vs CONVENIENCE
scenes.narration: More control, but more responsibility. Lose your recovery phrase, and the coins are gone.

scenes.head: TRADING vs HOLDING
scenes.narration: Rule of thumb: trading, keep it on an exchange. Long-term holding, consider your own wallet.

scenes.head: ONE CRYPTO BASIC A DAY
scenes.narration: Follow for one crypto basic a day. Not financial advice.
